text:
Alex: Quick sync 1 I noticed inconsistent casing and hyphenation across docs and SDK snippets. Small but noisy: examples include `Redwood-dedicated`, `Redwood Dedicated`, and `dedicated capacity` mixed in the same doc. Also param names: `model_id` vs `modelId` vs `model-id`.
Priya: Yep saw that too while working on the migration guide. Translators flagged abbreviated headers like 'Model v.'
Jordan: Proposal: product names Title Case (no hyphens), SDK params camelCase, CLI flags and filenames kebab-case, and JSON bodies camelCase to match SDK shapes.
Sam: Quick checklist would help reviewers. Can you paste a 1-line rule set in the PR, Alex?
Alex: Will do. Draft checklist in PR:
- Product names: Title Case (e.g., "Redwood Private").
- UI copy: sentence case.
- SDK params: camelCase (`modelId`, `maxTokens`).
- REST routes/flags/filenames: kebab-case.
- JSON payloads: camelCase.
- Avoid abbreviations in headers.
Priya: Add: show legacy->new examples in migration docs, e.g.,
```json
{ "legacy": { "model_id": "rw-1" }, "new": { "modelId": "rw-1" } }
```
Jordan: I'll run the snippet linter after the PR merges and auto-fix code blocks where possible. We have a script for that.
Sam: Two ops asks: 1) add a CONTRIBUTING note to search for `model_id` before merging; 2) add a Danger rule to warn when >5 files are changed with inconsistent casing.
Alex: Adding both. I'll also run a grep sweep after merging to open follow-ups for low-risk fixes.
docs-bot: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1293 opened by Alex 1 "style: token/orthography rules + migration snippet"
Priya: Reviewing now. I'll add comments with the two broken internal anchors I found.
Alex: Target merge by Friday so we can run bulk fixes next week. Ping this thread when you've reviewed.
Jordan: Got it. I'll queue the snippet CI run post-merge and share the auto-fix results here.
Sam: +1 from me. :thumbsup:
